fusions.name: Closing Pass
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 7 tiles to the target and deals 16 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding Snap
fusions.desc: A snap that deals 9 damage and heals you for 35% of the damage dealt. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: Your critical chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Frenzied Turn
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 30% of the damage you deal for 8 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
